INTEGRATION — MOSAIC IS A FIRST-CLASS DATASET GENERATOR, NOT A DEMO. run.ps1 (repo root, 85 lines) is a 6-stage end-to-end pipeline: [1] javac-build ScmsApp-0.1.0.jar (scms-sim/mosaic-apps/scms-app/build.ps1, no Maven, classpath = MOSAIC_HOME/lib/*); [2] python scms-sim/scenarios/gen_scenario.py <key> generates a wired scenario under scms-sim/scenarios/gen_<key>; [3] runs `mosaic.bat -c <cfg> -w 0` with cwd=MOSAIC_HOME, passing SCMS_OUT_DIR/SCMS_SEED env (run.ps1:55-70); [4] python -m scms_sim_ref.datagen.featurize; [5] datagen.validate; [6] datagen.datasheet (run.ps1:75-81). The Java backend (org.scms.backend.ScmsBackend, singleton, JVM shutdown hook, ScmsBackend.java:232-234, 563-649) writes the EXACT same dataset layout as the Python mock pipeline: ma/{ma_reports,ma_investigations,ma_crl_events,ma_cert_status}.jsonl + ground_truth/{gt_vehicle,gt_identity_map,gt_enrollment,gt_attacks,gt_report_labels,gt_linkage_revocation,gt_emissions_sample}.jsonl + manifest.json with per-file SHA-256 + data_digest (ScmsBackend.java:589-645). featurize.py explicitly consumes "either the Python reference pipeline or the MOSAIC layer" (featurize.py:1-22) and normalizes schema differences (_report_fields, featurize.py:92-103). Proof on disk: datasets/smoke is a MOSAIC-produced dataset (manifest generator "scms_sim_ref (MOSAIC layer, full-entity back-end v4)", 265 vehicles, 3770 reports, 34 revoked) WITH the full ml/ table set (report/subject/vehicle features+labels, graph_edges, subject_windows, parquet+csv). datagen/campaign.py (domain-randomization corpus, the flagship sim-to-real dataset) is built ENTIRELY on run.ps1/MOSAIC — it randomizes 25+ SCMS_* env knobs and map keys per domain and shells run.ps1 per domain (campaign.py:39-110). The GUI (gui.ps1 -> gui/server.py, port 8710) exposes generator choice "python-flow" (default) vs "mosaic" (server.py:96-99, 701-731). ADR 0001 chose MOSAIC+VeReMi-NextGen as the base stack (docs/adr/0001-stack-and-approach.md:16-25) with "SNS/Cell default, OMNeT++ for validation subsets" (line 51).

SCENARIOS (gen_scenario.py REG, lines 34-43): curated flow maps smoke(HelloWorld)/highway/barnim/tiergarten copied from MOSAIC bundle; 4 real-Ingolstadt route maps intas_urban_low|rush, intas_highway_low|rush sourced from third_party/veremi-nextgen submodule (VeReMi-NextGen Generator/simulation/mosaic/scenarios/InTAS_*_test, ~940MB routes each, junctioned not copied, gen_scenario.py:83-98; InTAS.db routing DB from the docker variant). NETWORK/RADIO SIMULATOR IN USE: MOSAIC SNS ONLY. Per-scenario sns/sns_config.json written by mapgen.write_sns_config (mapgen.py:159-172): singlehopRadius = SCMS_RADIO_RANGE (default 709.4 m), adhocTransmissionModel "SophisticatedAdhocTransmissionModel", SimpleRandomDelay 0.4-2.4 ms, lossProbability = SCMS_RADIO_LOSS (default 0.0), maxRetries 0. NextGen InTAS natively ships OMNeT++ configs (omnetpp.ini present, scenario_config omnetpp:true) but gen_scenario/make_scms_intas.ps1 swap it to SNS because OMNeT++ isn't installed. No cell (C-V2X), no ns-3 anywhere. App transmits topological singlehop broadcast on AdHoc CCH, power(50) (ScmsBeaconApp.java:120-121, 190-197); SignedCam declares nominal 300-byte payload so the radio model accounts on-air size (SignedCam.java:18).

DATA FLOW: SUMO (TraCI via mosaic-sumo ambassador) -> MOSAIC VehicleUpdates -> ScmsBeaconApp.onVehicleUpdated implements ETSI EN 302 637-2 CAM triggering (dPos>4m/dHdg>4°/dSpd>0.5m/s, T_GenCamMin 0.1s, T_GenCamMax 1s, ScmsBeaconApp.java:140-158) -> ScmsBackend.claim() applies GNSS/odometry sensor model (OU-correlated bias + white noise + heavy-tailed outliers + degradation bursts + weather multiplier + per-vehicle GNSS quality, ScmsBackend.java:355-399) then AttackLib falsification -> SNS delivers to in-range receivers -> receiver-side app-level channel hacks (weather drop, distance-NLOS, CBR-proxy congestion loss, ScmsBeaconApp.java:210-235) -> 10-detector suite incl. alpha-beta Kalman consistency (ScmsBeaconApp.java:244-394) -> ScmsBackend.onDetection (LOP->RA->MA, trusted-reporter reputation gating, K-distinct + persistence revocation, full SCMS entity model with LA1/LA2 linkage-seed CRL, ScmsBackend.java:476-560) -> JSONL dataset at JVM exit + live_state.json for GUI map. AttackLib has ~33 base behaviours × profile×tier variant matrix = 355 concrete enabled variants across 7 families incl. a stealth family (AlongRoadOffset/SlowDrift/LaggingPosition/Adaptive) (AttackLib.java:36-118; manifest attack_variants_enabled=355). MOSAIC<->SUMO sync: mapgen scenarios default updateInterval=100 ms (sim_step_ms, mapgen.py:121-123, 379-381); curated bundle + InTAS scenarios keep bundled updateInterval=1000 ms unless SCMS_SIM_STEP env set (gen_scenario.py:163-170; gen_smoke/sumo/sumo_config.json:2; InTAS sumo_config.json updateInterval 1000).

VERDICT: the MOSAIC path is the TRAFFIC-realism flagship (real SUMO microsimulation, real InTAS city, OSM import, biggest attack catalogue, powers the campaign corpus) and fully integrated with the dataset pipeline; it is NOT vestigial. Its NETWORK realism, however, is its weakest layer: a unit-disk SNS radio plus hand-rolled probabilistic in-app compensations. The pure-Python mock_pipeline remains the FEATURE flagship (RSUs, VRU/DENM, credential attacks, events timeline, 71 flags — FEATURES.md) and the GUI default; several of its features have no MOSAIC equivalent.
gaps: Radio is a unit-disk model: SNS SophisticatedAdhocTransmissionModel with fixed singlehopRadius 709.4 m, 0.4-2.4 ms random delay, static lossProbability 0 (mapgen.py:159-172). No PHY/MAC: no CSMA/CA contention, hidden terminals, capture effect, fading (Rayleigh/log-normal shadowing), Doppler, or per-frame SINR; transmit power(50) in ScmsBeaconApp.java:121 is effectively ignored by SNS.

All channel realism beyond range is faked receiver-side inside the application: weather drop (fixed 3-10% Bernoulli), NLOS as distance-ramp probability with no building geometry, and congestion as a per-receiver received-frame count CBR proxy (CHAN_CAPACITY 25/100ms) — ScmsBeaconApp.java:52-66, 210-235. InTAS ships real building polygons (InTAS.poly.xml/buildings.poly.xml) that are never used for LOS blocking.

High-fidelity network federates unavailable: tools/mosaic/bin/fed/{omnetpp,ns3} hold only Dockerfiles/Linux installers; scenario generator hard-disables omnetpp/ns3/cell (gen_scenario.py:106-107, mapgen.py:399-400). No C-V2X (PC5 sidelink/Uu) modeling at all despite mosaic-cell-25.2.jar being present.

Curated (smoke/highway/barnim/tiergarten) and InTAS scenarios run MOSAIC<->SUMO sync at 1000 ms by default (SCMS_SIM_STEP only honoured when explicitly set, gen_scenario.py:163-170), capping CAM generation at 1 Hz and neutering the ETSI 1-10 Hz dynamics rules and the 100 ms congestion window on precisely the most realistic maps; only mapgen procedural/OSM maps default to 100 ms.

No RSUs, traffic-light units, servers, or TMCs in the MOSAIC mapping — explicitly stripped (gen_scenario.py:118); the Python path's always-trusted RSU reporters and infrastructure graph nodes have no MOSAIC counterpart.

Demand realism on procedural/OSM maps is randomTrips uniform OD (period 1.5 s, fringe-factor 5, mapgen.py:290-298) — no gravity/activity-based OD, no calibrated counts, no per-hour profiles beyond crude depart-time reshaping (rush=quadratic front-load, night=keep 35%, mapgen.py:315-331); InTAS is the only calibrated-demand map.

Procedural netgenerate maps get NO traffic lights (no --tls options, mapgen.py:225-249) and fixed 2-lane roads; OSM import keeps passenger-only edges, discards buildings, bus/tram/pedestrian infrastructure, and uses tiny ~2 km2 bboxes (CITIES, mapgen.py:40-107).

Car-following realism gap: MOSAIC path uses SUMO default Krauss (InTAS explicitly sets default.carfollowmodel Krauss; mapgen vTypes set accel/decel/sigma/tau but never carFollowModel — no IDM/EIDM, no sublane model, no lane-change tuning), while the Python path advertises IDM; SUMO 1.25's EIDM is unused.

Attack-catalogue asymmetry vs the Python layer: MOSAIC AttackLib has no credential family (sigValid hardcoded true, SignedCam.java constructor), no VRU impersonation/spoofing, no DENM/FakeHazard events, no scenario-events timeline (close_edge/attack_wave/attack_zone), and no CRL-aware dormant attackers — featurize.py already reserves columns for several of these (featurize.py:37-62).
InTAS pedestrians and buses are simulated by SUMO but carry no V2X stack (only random_00X/default_00X passenger prototypes are mapped); no VRU awareness messages (VAM).

MOSAIC-bundled LuST (Luxembourg, full-day real-city scenario, tools/mosaic/scenarios/LuST) and Sievekingplatz are not wired into gen_scenario REG (gen_scenario.py:34-43) — a ready-made second real city is unused.

Report channel to the MA is an in-JVM function call with a sampled 0.15 s latency (INGEST_DELAY_S, ScmsBackend.java:112, 490); no networked V2I/cellular uplink path for misbehaviour reports or CRL distribution (CRL propagation is a scalar 2 s delay, ScmsBackend.java:50).

Multi-hop/GeoNetworking unused: all CAMs are topological().singlehop() broadcasts (ScmsBeaconApp.java:192-193); SNS maximumTtl 10 is irrelevant. No DCC (ETSI TS 102 687 decentralized congestion control) adapting CAM rate to channel load.
No Java-side tests for the MOSAIC app/backend (tests/ covers only the Python pipeline; only test_gui_parity.py mentions mosaic); the jar is built by javac with no CI.

The MOSAIC output federate's output.csv (VehicleUpdates ground track) is written but never consumed by the pipeline — SUMO-truth trajectories are not exported to the dataset beyond the 2% gt_emissions_sample (EMIT_SAMPLE, ScmsBackend.java:105).
